root: ^Oh hey grams. Anyone ever told you that you’re crazy?
^You’ve wandered into Agathol several times now and yet I've never heard of anyone, let alone met anyone else that has come back alive as many times as you have.
^What could possibly be down there that's worth risking your life for over and over again?
^My family always went on and on about the treasures but those dried up ages ago.
^Sigh… Is that so? Well grams, whatever it is , just be careful all right? My blades will only get you so far you know?
